title: Tuple Power
prompt:
Write three functions that work with tuples:

**Requirements:**
1. `make_point(x, y)` -- returns a tuple `(x, y)`
2. `distance(p1, p2)` -- computes Euclidean distance between two points (tuples of `(x, y)`)
3. `swap(a, b)` -- returns `(b, a)`

**Examples:**
```python
make_point(3, 4)           # (3, 4)
distance((0, 0), (3, 4))   # 5.0
swap(1, 2)                 # (2, 1)
```
hints: Tuples are created with parentheses: (x, y)
Access tuple elements by index: point[0], point[1]

solution.py.name: make_point
solution.py.description: Define a make_point function that accepts x and y parameters

solution.py.name: distance
solution.py.description: Define a distance function that accepts p1 and p2 parameters

solution.py.name: swap
solution.py.description: Define a swap function that accepts a and b parameters

solution.py.hint: Use parentheses to create a tuple: return (x, y)
